findings.text: the internal-label trim added in commit 4c47611ce is unguarded: reinstating the pre-fix f"{state_word}" (dropping entry_state from the strip argument) leaves every test green, so nothing fails if that fix regresses.

_display_state returns the empty string for any state outside PANE_STATES, so an unmapped state renders a blank state cell (or, on a first row, a blank right half) where the retired DISPLAY fallback showed the raw word; it is reachable only if the producer vocabulary outruns the enumeration test, but the failure is silent rather than surfaced.
